I fixed the bug in the format-spec parser in `youtube_dl/YoutubeDL.py` (`build_format_selector`). The failing test and the other 13 tests in `test/test_YoutubeDL.py` now pass. I didn't run the rest of the test suite.

**The bug:** when the parser hit a `/` (meaning "use this format, or fall back to that one"), it added the combined choice to the result list straight away and then cleared the current selector.
